description: Holds store requisition details records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to factory category, factory products.
business_purpose: Used to track and report store requisition details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One row represents one store requisition detail.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the store requisition detail.

columns.name: StoreRequisitionHeaderid
columns.description: Store requisition headerid of the store requisition detail.

columns.name: batch
columns.description: Batch of the store requisition detail.

columns.name: buying_price
columns.description: Buying price of the store requisition detail.

columns.name: categoryid
columns.description: Reference to the factory category linked to this store requisition detail.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

columns.name: last_bought_price
columns.description: Last bought price of the store requisition detail.

columns.name: productid
columns.description: Reference to the factory products linked to this store requisition detail.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Quantity of the store requisition detail.

columns.name: total_price
columns.description: Total price of the store requisition detail.

relationships.description: Each store requisition detail references one factory category (category).
Each store requisition detail references one factory products (product).

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should normally be excluded from reporting.
Use total_price / quantity for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to Factory Category, Factory Products through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
StoreRequisitionDetails is defined in the EF Core model but was not found in the connected database, so it may not be deployed there.
common_queries: Store Requisition Details by factory category
Store Requisition Details by factory products
Top factory category by buying price

known_issues: buying_price, last_bought_price, total_price are stored as floating point, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
buying_price, last_bought_price, quantity, total_price are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against StoreRequisitionDetails: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting store requisition detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(total_price) for totals of total price.
To resolve names, join on: categoryid = FactoryCategory.id; productid = FactoryProducts.id.
Defined in the EF Core model but not found in the connected database; confirm it has been migrated before relying on it.
